$l_1: \mathbf{r}=(3\mathbf{i}+p\mathbf{j}+7\mathbf{k})+\lambda(2\mathbf{i}-5\mathbf{j}+4\mathbf{k})$
$l_2: \mathbf{r}=(8\mathbf{i}-2\mathbf{j}+5\mathbf{k})+\mu(4\mathbf{i}+\mathbf{j}+2\mathbf{k})$
where $\lambda$ and $\mu$ are scalar parameters and $p$ is a constant.
Given that $l_1$ and $l_2$ intersect,
